supervision: Sealed own mesoscopic simulator ONLY; no SUMO or per-street Google circuit labels.
prediction_time: Estimated LOCAL arrival at each directed road
limitations: Only roads with actual synthetic vehicle exposure have speed observations; absent rows are NOT measured free-flow labels.
Night/peak comparisons use the same directed roads and at least 20 vehicle-seconds per period; unpaired roads are not evidence of temporal accuracy.
Declared temporal screening: >=25 paired roads and >=10% slowing by >10% for each weekday peak period. Not a Salvadoran calibration target.
Vehicle mix, OD, capacities, control timing and calendar/weekend assumptions remain uncalibrated priors.
No independent real route validation is possible from the current Google street-repeated circuit rows.
Train/test must split whole dates/weeks, with hour/day-type and regional balancing; do not random-split adjacent intervals.
Fixed four-vehicle groups and one-packet lane storage floor are mesoscopic approximations.
Most speed limits/lanes and all demand timing/OD/control capacities are uncalibrated priors where OSM lacks tags.
Weather, holidays, freight, buses/taxis and overnight demand are not independently calibrated.
Only about half of the prepared directed network is visited by the sampled OD routes; unsupported roads/times require uncertainty or an explicit structural prior, not confident traffic claims.
This approval concerns initial synthetic training viability, not a deployed routing safety claim or accuracy on future real Google observations.
No independent spatial-holdout or real-route accuracy claim.
Future speeds represent a mean synthetic scenario, not a deterministic real-day prediction.
Hourly profile and GPU neural residual form ONE bundle: .keras alone lacks the profile preprocessing.
